evidence.reason: The current claim_run_dir creates the run directory at line 612 and returns without fsyncing the record base (or its parent when the base is newly created). durable_write for the receipt syncs only the receipt and its parent run_dir, so the new run-directory entry in the record base can be lost on power failure even though admission is claimed and later state is written inside it. This is a routine durability repair, not a new requirement.
